candidate_rule: Lowest eligible selection J_round1 among whole_sheet/interior before confirmation; require all six confirmation units. No confirmation reselection or historical fallback.
reference_note: Mechanism starting values from topic4_data_driven_zm_ictal_transition_v1.json; not a transferred old s39 working point. Spatial per-neuron equations inherited unchanged.
mechanism_selection_rule: First prespecified active configuration with a tonic plateau, >=2 s pretransition and >=2 self-terminating population excursions in >=2/3 pilot seeds; validate this single configuration on three new dynamics seeds. No reranking on validation.
recurrence_check: Existing active-fraction detector at the inherited threshold; exclude first 200 ms and stop return assessment at onset minus 200 ms. Population excursions are diagnostic, not patient causal families or two propagation modes. New-noise slow-off controls must retain bounded recurrent events.

probe.assay: Identical checkpoint, all RNG states, slow variables and native delay rings; sham vs one forced E spike packet per site. Common noise within each state, paired sites across states. Report collisions and all signed responses. Exploratory 3x3 spatial grid.

claim_boundary: Operational tonic runaway, finite horizon censoring and state/parameter sensitivity only. No clinical seizure, physiological identification or bifurcation type established. No inherited old fold/escape value. No patient heldout or ictal data opened.
